# Antigravity Usage & Speed Monitor Local usage, speed, context, and quota monitor for Google Antigravity 2.0, Antigravity IDE, and Antigravity CLI, with no external npm dependencies. [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/yuhuan-dev/antigravity-usage-monitor?style=flat-square&color=2A5E76&label=release)](https://github.com/yuhuan-dev/antigravity-usage-monitor/releases/latest) [![Downloads](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/yuhuan-dev/antigravity-usage-monitor/total?style=flat-square&color=0ea5e9)](https://github.com/yuhuan-dev/antigravity-usage-monitor/releases) [![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/yuhuan-dev/antigravity-usage-monitor?style=flat-square&color=f59e0b)](https://github.com/yuhuan-dev/antigravity-usage-monitor/stargazers) [![License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/yuhuan-dev/antigravity-usage-monitor?style=flat-square&color=3b82f6)](LICENSE) [![Zero Dependencies](https://img.shields.io/badge/dependencies-0%20npm%20packages-10b981?style=flat-square)](#local-development) [![Platforms](https://img.shields.io/badge/platforms-Windows%20%7C%20macOS%20%7C%20Linux-6366f1?style=flat-square)](#client-support) English · [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) [Features](#features) · [Screenshots](#screenshots) · [Client Support](#client-support) · [Installation](#installation) · [Usage](#usage) · [Development](#local-development)

[Latest Release](https://github.com/yuhuan-dev/antigravity-usage-monitor/releases/latest) · [Download ZIP (`usage-monitor.zip`)](https://github.com/yuhuan-dev/antigravity-usage-monitor/releases/latest/download/usage-monitor.zip)
--- ## Features - **Live Metrics & Customizable Layout**: Tracks output speed (`tok/s`), time-to-first-token (`TTFT`), session average speed, step/session USD cost, cache hit rate, tightest remaining quota, and session tokens. You can choose and reorder the overview metric cards (4 shown by default out of 9 options) and section blocks. - **10-Category Context Breakdown**: Shows the token breakdown of the latest request across assistant replies, tool results, user messages, subagent notifications, checkpoints, system prompts, system tools, MCP tools, skills, and user rules, with a switcher between the main agent and spawned subagents. - **Quota Pool Tracking**: Reads 5-hour and weekly quotas, reset timers, and cycle consumption across `Gemini`, `Gemini 4 Argon`, `Gemini 4 Carbon`, and `Claude & GPT` pools, preserving cached pool status with a stale badge when upstream quota data is temporarily unavailable. - **Main Agent, Subagents & Multi-Session Views**: Merges main agent and subagent steps in chronological order (or filters by individual agent), renders optional turn rails, expands running subagent tasks inline, and provides a recent-conversation selector in the header. - **Call Details & Custom Token Formats**: Includes **By Step** and **By Model** tabs (with multi-model throughput charts). Supports 2–14 configurable columns, optional speed color grading, preset `Ctx / Think / Reply` and `In / Out / Cache` columns, and custom token combination strings such as `context:new:cache` or `in:out:cache`. - **Historical Usage & Breakdowns**: Summarizes tokens, uncached input vs. cache-read savings, thinking/output split, hourly/daily trend curves, model rankings, client attribution (`Desktop App` / `IDE` / `CLI`), and monthly bar charts across `Today`, `1d`, `7d`, `14d`, `30d`, `All`, or custom date/time ranges. - **Multi-Client Capsules & Hover Popover**: Integrates as a titlebar or composer capsule and auxiliary sidebar in Antigravity 2.0, a titlebar/composer capsule in Antigravity IDE, a single-line 24-bit ANSI `statusLine` in Antigravity CLI (`agy`), and a standalone local web UI. Supports 1–5 customizable capsule slots, configurable hover cards, and `Auto Fit` or fixed (`440–1080 px`) popover widths. - **No `app.asar` Modification**: Titlebar/composer injection and context request hooks run in memory over local CDP (`DevToolsActivePort`). On Antigravity IDE, the only host file updated is adding `"remote-debugging-port": "0"` to `~/.antigravity-ide/argv.json`; installation binaries and `app.asar` are never altered. - **Per-Model Context Windows**: Sets context window limits per model series (across thinking levels) or follows host defaults under Settings. Desktop/IDE applies rules at runtime on outbound requests; CLI applies `AGY_CLI_AUTO_COMPACT_OVERRIDE`. - **Appearance, Offline Storage & Cloud Updates**: Supports `zh-CN` / `en-US` / host language, `sm / md / lg / xl` font scaling, 6 theme accents plus host matching, offline reading from CLI SQLite + WAL, `annotations/*.pbtxt`, `transcript.jsonl`, and `.deep_stats_cache.json`, GitHub [`pricing-catalog.json`](pricing-catalog.json) sync, in-panel release updates (`manual` / `auto` / `off`), and cache rebuild/settings reset tools. --- ## Screenshots ### IDE & CLI

Antigravity IDE
Titlebar capsule and hover popover showing step cost, context usage, and pool quotas

Antigravity CLI (agy)
Single-line transparent 24-bit ANSI bottom statusLine with active count, TPS, TTFT, and context percentage
### Panel Tabs

Live Overview
TPS, TTFT, 10-category context bar, quota pools, and active tasks
Usage Statistics
Token totals, cache hit rate, trend chart, and model breakdown
Call Details
Step-by-step agent badge, model, speed, TTFT, tokens, and cost
--- ## Client Support | Client | Status Capsule / Bar | Panel UI | Offline SQLite & Logs | Per-Model Context Limit | Modifies `app.asar` | | :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | | **Antigravity 2.0 (Desktop)** | Titlebar / Composer | Popover + Right Sidebar | Yes | Window Request Hook | No | | **Antigravity IDE** | Titlebar / Composer | Capsule Popover | Yes | Window Request Hook | No | | **Antigravity CLI (`agy`)** | Native ANSI `statusLine` | Standalone Web (`--port`) | Yes (`node:sqlite` + `.pbtxt`) | `AGY_CLI_AUTO_COMPACT_OVERRIDE` | No | | **Remote / Headless Linux** | Native ANSI `statusLine` | SSH Tunnel / `--token` Web | Yes | `AGY_CLI_AUTO_COMPACT_OVERRIDE` | No | > [!NOTE] > On **Antigravity IDE**, enabling the plugin automatically adds `"remote-debugging-port": "0"` to `~/.antigravity-ide/argv.json` (preserving comments and existing keys) via a zero-tool MCP keep-alive entry (`0` context tokens). Restart Antigravity IDE once after the first activation so the titlebar capsule can attach. --- ## Installation Keep the folder name as `usage-monitor`. **No `npm install` is needed.** ### Option 1: Release ZIP Download [`usage-monitor.zip`](https://github.com/yuhuan-dev/antigravity-usage-monitor/releases/latest/download/usage-monitor.zip) and extract it into `~/.gemini/config/plugins/` so the directory path is `~/.gemini/config/plugins/usage-monitor`.
Windows PowerShell command for ZIP installation ```powershell $pluginsDir = "$env:USERPROFILE\.gemini\config\plugins" New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $pluginsDir -Force | Out-Null Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "https://github.com/yuhuan-dev/antigravity-usage-monitor/releases/latest/download/usage-monitor.zip" -OutFile "$env:TEMP\usage-monitor.zip" Expand-Archive -Path "$env:TEMP\usage-monitor.zip" -DestinationPath $pluginsDir -Force ```
### Option 2: Git Clone ```powershell # Windows (PowerShell) git clone --filter=blob:none --single-branch https://github.com/yuhuan-dev/antigravity-usage-monitor.git "$env:USERPROFILE\.gemini\config\plugins\usage-monitor" ``` ```bash # macOS / Linux git clone --filter=blob:none --single-branch https://github.com/yuhuan-dev/antigravity-usage-monitor.git ~/.gemini/config/plugins/usage-monitor ``` Or ask Antigravity directly: ```text Clone https://github.com/yuhuan-dev/antigravity-usage-monitor with --filter=blob:none --single-branch to ~/.gemini/config/plugins/usage-monitor and enable the plugin ``` --- ## Usage 1. Open **Customizations → Installed** in the left sidebar and enable `usage-monitor`. 2. **Antigravity 2.0 (Desktop)**: - Mounts a capsule in the top-right titlebar (**hover** for summary, **click** for the 4-tab popover, **right-click** to refresh), alongside the right auxiliary sidebar pane. 3. **Antigravity IDE**: - **Restart Antigravity IDE once** after enabling for the first time. Keep **Mount Mode** on **Dual-mount** and click the top-bar capsule to open the panel. 4. **Antigravity CLI (`agy`)**: - When `~/.gemini/antigravity-cli` exists, `statusLine` in `settings.json` is configured automatically (existing third-party `statusLine.command` entries are left untouched) to render a single-line ANSI bar (`● 1 active 38.1 t/s | 0.85s | ◎ 17%`). - Toggle via `/statusline` in `agy` or **Preferences → Structure → Mount & Capsule Bar**. 5. **Standalone Web Server (Headless / Remote)**: ```bash # 1. Start on the host (listens on 127.0.0.1:8787 by default) node ~/.gemini/config/plugins/usage-monitor/sidecars/panel/standalone.mjs --port 8787 # 2. Forward the port locally and open http://localhost:8787 ssh -L 8787:127.0.0.1:8787 user@your-server ```
Standalone CLI flags, background auto-start, and non-loopback token auth - **Auto-start with `agy`**: Set `USAGE_MONITOR_STANDALONE_PORT=8787` or `"standalonePort": 8787` in `~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/sidecar_data/usage-monitor/panel/data/settings.json` to start the web UI together with the MCP sidecar supervisor. - **Non-loopback auth**: Binding to `0.0.0.0` or a LAN address requires `--token ` (or `USAGE_MONITOR_STANDALONE_TOKEN`); starting on a non-loopback address without a token is rejected. - **Overrides**: Supports `--data-dir`, `--app-data-dir`, `--gemini-dir`, `--ls-addr`, and `--csrf-token`. - **Offline fallback**: When `agy` is not running, the backend reads `~/.gemini/antigravity-cli` (`conversation_summaries.db`, `conversations/*.db`, `annotations/*.pbtxt`, and `transcript.jsonl`) and switches to live RPC once `agy` starts.
--- ## Configuration & Calculation Notes
UI options: mount mode, capsule slots, token formats, model IDs, and context limits - **Mount Mode & Width**: Switch between **Dual-mount (Top Bar + Sidebar)**, **Composer**, and **Sidebar only**. Popover width defaults to **Auto Fit** (expands within window bounds for wide tables) or a fixed width (`440–1080 px`). - **Capsule Slots**: Choose 1–5 metric slots and reorder them (default: Output Speed, TTFT, Context Usage), plus an optional toggle for the active-session indicator. - **Call Details Table & Token Format**: Toggle agent badges, turn rail (off by default), and speed color grading (off by default). Choose `Ctx / Think / Reply`, `In / Out / Cache` (with per-item USD tooltips), or custom format strings like `context:new:cache` or `in:out:cache`. - **Model Name Format**: Choose **Compact short alias** (`argon-4-high`), **Full raw ID**, or **Trimmed raw ID** (strips `gemini-` / `claude-` / `gpt-` prefixes while keeping `·compact` suffixes intact). Orchestrator series IDs have a separate setting. - **Per-Model Context Limits**: Configure limits per model across thinking levels or follow host defaults under **Preferences → Other → Model Context Settings**. App/IDE applies saved rules at startup; CLI sets `AGY_CLI_AUTO_COMPACT_OVERRIDE`.
Model identification, compaction inference, and cost estimation rules - **Model Resolution**: Read from each step's raw usage payload or matching generator metadata; explicit models are never overwritten. When an automatic compaction step omits the model field, it is inferred from adjacent steps in the same conversation (checking prior steps first, then following steps, preferring the same provider) for display and estimation, or shown as unknown compaction if none exist. - **Cost Calculation**: If a model or price entry cannot be resolved, step cost is shown as pending while tokens still count toward totals; session totals sum all resolved steps. USD numbers are estimated from public per-million-token API pricing in [`pricing-catalog.json`](pricing-catalog.json) for reference only and do **not** reflect subscription quota consumption. - **Cache & Speed Averages**: Upgrading re-checks cached entries against raw trajectory data while preserving token counts and valid timings. Compaction steps display request TPS in step tables but are excluded from session speed and TTFT averages.
Updating and data directory - **In-Panel Update**: When a new GitHub release is available, a version badge appears next to the capsule and in the panel header. Update mode (`Manual` / `Auto` / `Off`) and price catalog sync can be configured under **Preferences → Other**. - **Manual Git Update**: - Windows: `git -C "$env:USERPROFILE\.gemini\config\plugins\usage-monitor" pull --ff-only` - macOS / Linux: `git -C ~/.gemini/config/plugins/usage-monitor pull --ff-only` - Toggle the plugin off and back on in **Customizations → Installed**. - **Data Persistence**: Settings and parsed caches live in `~/.gemini/antigravity/sidecar_data/usage-monitor/` (or `sidecars/panel/.data/` in standalone mode), so updates keep existing history intact.
--- ## Local Development All backend and frontend modules use Node.js ESM and native Web Components with **no external npm dependencies** (Node.js 22.5+ is recommended for built-in `node:sqlite`). ```bash cd sidecars/panel # Rebuild app.js and styles.css after modifying src/ npm run build # Run unit and integration tests npm test ``` ## Contributing & License Issues and pull requests are welcome. If you modify files under `sidecars/panel/src/`, please rebuild via `npm run build` and make sure `npm test` passes. Licensed under the [GNU General Public License v3.0](LICENSE). ## Star History

# Antigravity Usage & Speed Monitor Google Antigravity 2.0、Antigravity IDE 与 Antigravity CLI 的本地用量、速率、上下文与配额监控插件，无外部 npm 依赖。 [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/yuhuan-dev/antigravity-usage-monitor?style=flat-square&color=2A5E76&label=release)](https://github.com/yuhuan-dev/antigravity-usage-monitor/releases/latest) [![Downloads](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/yuhuan-dev/antigravity-usage-monitor/total?style=flat-square&color=0ea5e9)](https://github.com/yuhuan-dev/antigravity-usage-monitor/releases) [![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/yuhuan-dev/antigravity-usage-monitor?style=flat-square&color=f59e0b)](https://github.com/yuhuan-dev/antigravity-usage-monitor/stargazers) [![License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/yuhuan-dev/antigravity-usage-monitor?style=flat-square&color=3b82f6)](LICENSE) [![Zero Dependencies](https://img.shields.io/badge/dependencies-0%20npm%20%E4%BE%9D%E8%B5%96-10b981?style=flat-square)](#本地开发) [![Platforms](https://img.shields.io/badge/platforms-Windows%20%7C%20macOS%20%7C%20Linux-6366f1?style=flat-square)](#客户端支持) [English](README.md) · 简体中文 [功能](#功能) · [截图](#截图) · [客户端支持](#客户端支持) · [安装](#安装) · [使用方式](#使用方式) · [开发](#本地开发)

[下载最新版本 (Releases)](https://github.com/yuhuan-dev/antigravity-usage-monitor/releases/latest) · [下载压缩包 (`usage-monitor.zip`)](https://github.com/yuhuan-dev/antigravity-usage-monitor/releases/latest/download/usage-monitor.zip)
--- ## 功能 - **实时指标与版面编排**：统计单步输出速度（`tok/s`）、首字延迟（`TTFT`）、会话平均速度、单步/累计费用、缓存命中率、最紧缺配额与已用 Token；可在设置中从 9 项指标中自由勾选并拖拽排序（默认展示 4 项），并调整实时监控各模块顺序。 - **10 类上下文窗口构成**：展示最近一次请求的上下文占比，按占用列出模型回复、工具结果、用户消息、子代理通知、压缩摘要、系统提示词、系统工具、MCP 工具、Skill 与用户规则，支持在主代理与任意子代理之间切换查看。 - **配额池监控与过期提示**：追踪 `Gemini`、`Gemini 4 Argon`、`Gemini 4 Carbon` 与 `Claude & GPT` 配额池的 5 小时及每周余量、重置倒计时与周期累计用量；上游接口暂未返回新数据时保留缓存余量并显示陈旧提示。 - **主/子代理联动与多会话管理**：按时间归并展示主代理与各子代理调用步骤（也可按单一代理过滤），支持可选轮次分组导轨与运行中子代理卡片原地展开，并在顶栏切换最近会话。 - **调用明细与自定义 Token 格式**：包含「按步查看」与「按模型汇总」（含多模型拟合图）；支持增删与排序 2–14 列、独立开关速度分段配色，除预设的 `上下文 / 思考 / 正文` 和 `输入 / 输出 / 缓存` 外，可通过 `context:new:cache`、`in:out:cache` 等语法自定义 Token 组合展示。 - **历史用量与来源统计**：按今天、1 天、7 天、14 天、30 天、全部或自定义起止日期时间统计总 Token、新输入与缓存读取节省金额、输出/思考拆分、按小时/按天趋势折线图、模型排行、客户端来源（App / IDE / CLI）与月度柱状图。 - **多端胶囊与悬浮速览**：支持 Antigravity 2.0 顶栏/输入框停靠胶囊与右侧辅助栏、Antigravity IDE 顶栏/输入框胶囊、Antigravity CLI（`agy`）单行 24-bit ANSI `statusLine` 与独立 Web 页面；支持自定义 1–5 个胶囊指标槽位、悬停速览卡片内容以及自动适宽（或 `440~1080 px` 固定宽度）。 - **不修改 `app.asar`**：桌面端与 IDE 的胶囊挂载及上下文请求改写均在运行时通过本地 CDP 内存注入完成（IDE 首次启用时仅向 `~/.antigravity-ide/argv.json` 写入 `"remote-debugging-port": "0"`，保留注释与原有配置），不触碰宿主安装包与 `app.asar`。 - **按模型设置上下文窗口**：支持按模型系列（跨思考档位）统一指定上下文上限或跟随宿主默认；桌面端与 IDE 在请求层生效，CLI 通过环境变量 `AGY_CLI_AUTO_COMPACT_OVERRIDE` 控制。 - **外观定制、离线读取与云端同步**：提供简体中文 / English / 自动跟随宿主语言、`sm / md / lg / xl` 字号、6 种主题强调色（含跟随宿主主题）；离线支持直读 CLI SQLite + WAL、`annotations/*.pbtxt`、`transcript.jsonl` 与 `.deep_stats_cache.json`；内置 GitHub [`pricing-catalog.json`](pricing-catalog.json) 同步、压缩步骤模型推断、面板内更新（手动 / 自动 / 关闭）及缓存重建与配置重置。 --- ## 截图 ### IDE 与 CLI

Antigravity IDE
顶栏悬浮胶囊与速览浮窗，显示当前步骤费用、上下文占用与配额状态

Antigravity CLI (agy)
终端底栏单行 24-bit ANSI 无背景色 statusLine，显示活跃会话数、输出速率、首字延迟与上下文占比
### 面板标签页

实时监控
输出速率、首字延迟、10 类上下文明细、配额池与运行中任务
用量统计
Token 汇总、缓存命中率、趋势曲线与分模型用量排行
调用明细
按步列出代理归属、模型、速率、首字延迟、Token 构成与费用
--- ## 客户端支持 | 客户端 / 运行环境 | 状态胶囊 / 底栏 | 监控面板 | 离线 SQLite 与日志读取 | 按模型上下文限制 | 修改 `app.asar` | | :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | | **Antigravity 2.0 桌面端** | 顶栏 / 输入框停靠 | 悬浮窗 + 右侧辅助栏 | 支持 | 请求级重写钩子 | 否 | | **Antigravity IDE** | 顶栏 / 输入框停靠 | 点击胶囊展开面板 | 支持 | 请求级重写钩子 | 否 | | **Antigravity CLI (`agy`)** | 终端底栏 `statusLine` | 独立 Web (`--port`) | 支持（`node:sqlite` + `.pbtxt`） | `AGY_CLI_AUTO_COMPACT_OVERRIDE` | 否 | | **无头服务器 / SSH 远程** | 终端底栏 `statusLine` | SSH 隧道 / `--token` Web | 支持 | `AGY_CLI_AUTO_COMPACT_OVERRIDE` | 否 | > [!NOTE] > 在 **Antigravity IDE** 中首次启用插件时，后台会通过零工具开销的 MCP 保活入口（不消耗上下文 Token）向 `~/.antigravity-ide/argv.json` 写入 `"remote-debugging-port": "0"`（保留原有注释与配置项）。首次启用后需重启一次 IDE，顶栏胶囊才能正常挂载。 --- ## 安装 插件目录名需保持为 `usage-monitor`，**无需运行 `npm install`**。 ### 方式一：下载 Release 压缩包 下载 [`usage-monitor.zip`](https://github.com/yuhuan-dev/antigravity-usage-monitor/releases/latest/download/usage-monitor.zip)，解压到 `~/.gemini/config/plugins/` 下并保持文件夹名为 `usage-monitor`。
Windows PowerShell 下载及解压命令 ```powershell $pluginsDir = "$env:USERPROFILE\.gemini\config\plugins" New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $pluginsDir -Force | Out-Null Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "https://github.com/yuhuan-dev/antigravity-usage-monitor/releases/latest/download/usage-monitor.zip" -OutFile "$env:TEMP\usage-monitor.zip" Expand-Archive -Path "$env:TEMP\usage-monitor.zip" -DestinationPath $pluginsDir -Force ```
### 方式二：Git 克隆 ```powershell # Windows PowerShell git clone --filter=blob:none --single-branch https://github.com/yuhuan-dev/antigravity-usage-monitor.git "$env:USERPROFILE\.gemini\config\plugins\usage-monitor" ``` ```bash # macOS / Linux git clone --filter=blob:none --single-branch https://github.com/yuhuan-dev/antigravity-usage-monitor.git ~/.gemini/config/plugins/usage-monitor ``` 也可以直接在 Antigravity 对话中执行： ```text 把 https://github.com/yuhuan-dev/antigravity-usage-monitor 用 --filter=blob:none --single-branch 克隆到 ~/.gemini/config/plugins/usage-monitor 并启用插件 ``` --- ## 使用方式 1. 打开左侧边栏 **Customizations → Installed**，找到 `usage-monitor` 并开启。 2. **Antigravity 2.0 桌面端**： - 主窗口右上角挂载悬浮胶囊（**悬停**查看速览，**左键**打开四标签面板，**右键**强制刷新），同时可在右侧辅助栏打开「用量监控」。 3. **Antigravity IDE**： - 首次启用后**重启一次 Antigravity IDE**，保持挂载方式为「双栖挂载」，点击顶栏胶囊即可打开面板。 4. **Antigravity CLI (`agy`) 底部胶囊**： - 检测到 `~/.gemini/antigravity-cli` 时自动写入原生 `statusLine` 配置（保留已有自定义 `statusLine.command`），在终端底栏单行显示当前活跃状态、输出速率、首字延迟与上下文占比（如 `● 1 运行中 38.1 t/s | 0.85s | ◎ 17%`）。 - 可在 `agy` 中通过 `/statusline` 或在面板 **偏好设置 → 界面编排 → 挂载胶囊** 开关及调整显示顺序。 5. **独立 Web 服务（纯终端 / 远程服务器）**： ```bash # 1. 在远程服务器上启动（默认监听 127.0.0.1:8787） node ~/.gemini/config/plugins/usage-monitor/sidecars/panel/standalone.mjs --port 8787 # 2. 本地端口转发后，浏览器访问 http://localhost:8787 ssh -L 8787:127.0.0.1:8787 user@your-server ```
独立 Web 命令行参数、随 agy 自动启动与非回环令牌校验 - **随 `agy` 自动启动**：设置环境变量 `USAGE_MONITOR_STANDALONE_PORT=8787`，或在 `~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/sidecar_data/usage-monitor/panel/data/settings.json` 中添加 `"standalonePort": 8787`，插件随 MCP 进程启动时会自动拉起 Web 服务。 - **非回环访问校验**：绑定 `0.0.0.0` 或局域网 IP 时必须提供 `--token <密钥>`（或环境变量 `USAGE_MONITOR_STANDALONE_TOKEN`），未设置令牌会拒绝启动。 - **常用参数**：支持 `--data-dir`、`--app-data-dir`、`--gemini-dir`、`--ls-addr` 与 `--csrf-token`。 - **离线数据读取**：在 `agy` 未运行的状态下，后台直接读取 `~/.gemini/antigravity-cli` 下的 `conversation_summaries.db`、`conversations/*.db`、`annotations/*.pbtxt` 与 `transcript.jsonl`，待 `agy` 启动后自动切换为实时 RPC 数据。
--- ## 配置说明与计算口径
界面与字段配置（挂载方式、胶囊槽位、Token 组合格式、模型命名与上下文限制） - **挂载模式与浮窗宽度**：支持「双栖挂载（顶部栏 + 侧边栏）」、「输入框挂载」与「仅侧边栏」；悬浮窗默认使用「自动适配」（宽表格下在窗口范围内自动加宽），也可设置为 `440~1080 px` 固定宽度。 - **胶囊槽位**：支持在 1 至 5 个指标间增删与排序（默认显示输出速度、首字延迟与上下文占用），并可单独开关运行中会话指示器。 - **调用明细与 Token 组合**：在「界面编排 → 调用明细字段」可分别开关主/子代理标识、对话轮次导轨（默认关闭）与输出速度多色分级（默认关闭）；Token 列默认显示 `上下文 / 思考 / 正文`，可切换至 `输入 / 输出 / 缓存` 预设（悬停显示美元分项），或使用 `context:new:cache`、`in:out:cache` 等自定义格式字符串。 - **模型命名格式**：支持精简代号（如 `argon-4-high`）、原始模型 ID 与去前缀原始 ID（去掉 `gemini-` / `claude-` / `gpt-` 前缀并保留 `·压缩` 标记）三档；Orchestrator 系列支持单独设置。 - **按模型设置上下文窗口**：在「其他 → 模型上下文设置」中为同一模型的各推理档位设置统一上限或「跟随宿主设置」。App / IDE 会在启动后作用于后续请求；CLI 通过 `AGY_CLI_AUTO_COMPACT_OVERRIDE` 控制。
模型识别、压缩步骤推断与费用折算说明 - **模型识别规则**：直接读取当前步骤的原始用量字段与对应生成记录，已记录的模型不会被后续推断覆盖。当上下文压缩步骤缺少模型字段时，按同一会话内「先向前、后向后，优先同提供方、再放宽匹配」的顺序推断用于展示与费用估算；无可推断来源时标注为「模型未知·压缩」。 - **费用计算口径**：模型或价格项未匹配时，单步费用记为「待定」，Token 数量仍正常统计；汇总金额仅累加已确认单价的步骤。美元金额基于 [`pricing-catalog.json`](pricing-catalog.json) 中的公开 API 单价估算，仅供本地对比参考，不代表订阅配额扣减比例。 - **升级校验与均速口径**：插件升级后会按原始轨迹重新校验旧缓存，同时保留既有 Token 与有效计时；压缩步骤在调用明细中展示完整请求 TPS，但不会计入会话平均生成速度与平均首字延迟。
更新方式与本地数据目录 - **面板内检查更新**：检测到 GitHub 新版本时，胶囊旁与面板顶栏会显示更新标记，点击后拉取更新并自动重载；可在 **偏好设置 → 其他** 选择「手动提示 / 自动更新 / 关闭」，或手动同步价格表。 - **Git 手动更新**： - Windows：`git -C "$env:USERPROFILE\.gemini\config\plugins\usage-monitor" pull --ff-only` - macOS / Linux：`git -C ~/.gemini/config/plugins/usage-monitor pull --ff-only` - 更新后在 **Customizations → Installed** 重新开关一次插件生效。 - **数据目录**：缓存与设置保存在 `~/.gemini/antigravity/sidecar_data/usage-monitor/`（独立模式未指定 `ANTIGRAVITY_EXECUTABLE_DATA_DIR` 时存放在 `sidecars/panel/.data/`），升级插件不会清除历史记录。
--- ## 本地开发 前后端代码采用纯 Node.js ESM 与原生 Web Components 编写，**无外部 npm 依赖**（建议使用 Node.js 22.5+ 以使用内置 `node:sqlite`）。 ```bash cd sidecars/panel # 修改 src/ 下源码后重新构建 app.js 与 styles.css npm run build # 运行单元测试与回归测试 npm test ``` ## 参与贡献与开源协议 欢迎提交 Issue 或 Pull Request。若修改了 `sidecars/panel/src/` 下的前端源码，请先执行 `npm run build` 重新生成产物，并确保 `npm test` 全部通过。 本项目基于 [GNU General Public License v3.0](LICENSE) 开源。 ## Star 趋势

# Antigravity Usage & Speed Monitor Local usage, speed, context, and quota monitor for Google Antigravity 2.0, Antigravity IDE, and Antigravity CLI, with no external npm dependencies. [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/yuhuan-dev/antigravity-usage-monitor?style=flat-square&color=2A5E76&label=release)](https://github.com/yuhuan-dev/antigravity-usage-monitor/releases/latest) [![Downloads](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/yuhuan-dev/antigravity-usage-monitor/total?style=flat-square&color=0ea5e9)](https://github.com/yuhuan-dev/antigravity-usage-monitor/releases) [![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/yuhuan-dev/antigravity-usage-monitor?style=flat-square&color=f59e0b)](https://github.com/yuhuan-dev/antigravity-usage-monitor/stargazers) [![License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/yuhuan-dev/antigravity-usage-monitor?style=flat-square&color=3b82f6)](LICENSE) [![Zero Dependencies](https://img.shields.io/badge/dependencies-0%20npm%20packages-10b981?style=flat-square)](#local-development) [![Platforms](https://img.shields.io/badge/platforms-Windows%20%7C%20macOS%20%7C%20Linux-6366f1?style=flat-square)](#client-support) English · [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) [Features](#features) · [Screenshots](#screenshots) · [Client Support](#client-support) · [Installation](#installation) · [Usage](#usage) · [Development](#local-development)

[Latest Release](https://github.com/yuhuan-dev/antigravity-usage-monitor/releases/latest) · [Download ZIP (`usage-monitor.zip`)](https://github.com/yuhuan-dev/antigravity-usage-monitor/releases/latest/download/usage-monitor.zip)
--- ## Features - **Live Metrics & Customizable Layout**: Tracks output speed (`tok/s`), time-to-first-token (`TTFT`), session average speed, step/session USD cost, cache hit rate, tightest remaining quota, and session tokens. You can choose and reorder the overview metric cards (4 shown by default out of 9 options) and section blocks. - **10-Category Context Breakdown**: Shows the token breakdown of the latest request across assistant replies, tool results, user messages, subagent notifications, checkpoints, system prompts, system tools, MCP tools, skills, and user rules, with a switcher between the main agent and spawned subagents. - **Quota Pool Tracking**: Reads 5-hour and weekly quotas, reset timers, and cycle consumption across `Gemini`, `Gemini 4 Argon`, `Gemini 4 Carbon`, and `Claude & GPT` pools, preserving cached pool status with a stale badge when upstream quota data is temporarily unavailable. - **Main Agent, Subagents & Multi-Session Views**: Merges main agent and subagent steps in chronological order (or filters by individual agent), renders optional turn rails, expands running subagent tasks inline, and provides a recent-conversation selector in the header. - **Call Details & Custom Token Formats**: Includes **By Step** and **By Model** tabs (with multi-model throughput charts). Supports 2–14 configurable columns, optional speed color grading, preset `Ctx / Think / Reply` and `In / Out / Cache` columns, and custom token combination strings such as `context:new:cache` or `in:out:cache`. - **Historical Usage & Breakdowns**: Summarizes tokens, uncached input vs. cache-read savings, thinking/output split, hourly/daily trend curves, model rankings, client attribution (`Desktop App` / `IDE` / `CLI`), and monthly bar charts across `Today`, `1d`, `7d`, `14d`, `30d`, `All`, or custom date/time ranges. - **Multi-Client Capsules & Hover Popover**: Integrates as a titlebar or composer capsule and auxiliary sidebar in Antigravity 2.0, a titlebar/composer capsule in Antigravity IDE, a single-line 24-bit ANSI `statusLine` in Antigravity CLI (`agy`), and a standalone local web UI. Supports 1–5 customizable capsule slots, configurable hover cards, and `Auto Fit` or fixed (`440–1080 px`) popover widths. - **No `app.asar` Modification**: Titlebar/composer injection and context request hooks run in memory over local CDP (`DevToolsActivePort`). On Antigravity IDE, the only host file updated is adding `"remote-debugging-port": "0"` to `~/.antigravity-ide/argv.json`; installation binaries and `app.asar` are never altered. - **Per-Model Context Windows**: Sets context window limits per model series (across thinking levels) or follows host defaults under Settings. Desktop/IDE applies rules at runtime on outbound requests; CLI applies `AGY_CLI_AUTO_COMPACT_OVERRIDE`. - **Appearance, Offline Storage & Cloud Updates**: Supports `zh-CN` / `en-US` / host language, `sm / md / lg / xl` font scaling, 6 theme accents plus host matching, offline reading from CLI SQLite + WAL, `annotations/*.pbtxt`, `transcript.jsonl`, and `.deep_stats_cache.json`, GitHub [`pricing-catalog.json`](pricing-catalog.json) sync, in-panel release updates (`manual` / `auto` / `off`), and cache rebuild/settings reset tools. --- ## Screenshots ### IDE & CLI

--- ## Client Support | Client | Status Capsule / Bar | Panel UI | Offline SQLite & Logs | Per-Model Context Limit | Modifies `app.asar` | | :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | | **Antigravity 2.0 (Desktop)** | Titlebar / Composer | Popover + Right Sidebar | Yes | Window Request Hook | No | | **Antigravity IDE** | Titlebar / Composer | Capsule Popover | Yes | Window Request Hook | No | | **Antigravity CLI (`agy`)** | Native ANSI `statusLine` | Standalone Web (`--port`) | Yes (`node:sqlite` + `.pbtxt`) | `AGY_CLI_AUTO_COMPACT_OVERRIDE` | No | | **Remote / Headless Linux** | Native ANSI `statusLine` | SSH Tunnel / `--token` Web | Yes | `AGY_CLI_AUTO_COMPACT_OVERRIDE` | No | > [!NOTE] > On **Antigravity IDE**, enabling the plugin automatically adds `"remote-debugging-port": "0"` to `~/.antigravity-ide/argv.json` (preserving comments and existing keys) via a zero-tool MCP keep-alive entry (`0` context tokens). Restart Antigravity IDE once after the first activation so the titlebar capsule can attach. --- ## Installation Keep the folder name as `usage-monitor`. **No `npm install` is needed.** ### Option 1: Release ZIP Download [`usage-monitor.zip`](https://github.com/yuhuan-dev/antigravity-usage-monitor/releases/latest/download/usage-monitor.zip) and extract it into `~/.gemini/config/plugins/` so the directory path is `~/.gemini/config/plugins/usage-monitor`.
Windows PowerShell command for ZIP installation ```powershell $pluginsDir = "$env:USERPROFILE\.gemini\config\plugins" New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $pluginsDir -Force | Out-Null Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "https://github.com/yuhuan-dev/antigravity-usage-monitor/releases/latest/download/usage-monitor.zip" -OutFile "$env:TEMP\usage-monitor.zip" Expand-Archive -Path "$env:TEMP\usage-monitor.zip" -DestinationPath $pluginsDir -Force ```
### Option 2: Git Clone ```powershell # Windows (PowerShell) git clone --filter=blob:none --single-branch https://github.com/yuhuan-dev/antigravity-usage-monitor.git "$env:USERPROFILE\.gemini\config\plugins\usage-monitor" ``` ```bash # macOS / Linux git clone --filter=blob:none --single-branch https://github.com/yuhuan-dev/antigravity-usage-monitor.git ~/.gemini/config/plugins/usage-monitor ``` Or ask Antigravity directly: ```text Clone https://github.com/yuhuan-dev/antigravity-usage-monitor with --filter=blob:none --single-branch to ~/.gemini/config/plugins/usage-monitor and enable the plugin ``` --- ## Usage 1. Open **Customizations → Installed** in the left sidebar and enable `usage-monitor`. 2. **Antigravity 2.0 (Desktop)**: - Mounts a capsule in the top-right titlebar (**hover** for summary, **click** for the 4-tab popover, **right-click** to refresh), alongside the right auxiliary sidebar pane. 3. **Antigravity IDE**: - **Restart Antigravity IDE once** after enabling for the first time. Keep **Mount Mode** on **Dual-mount** and click the top-bar capsule to open the panel. 4. **Antigravity CLI (`agy`)**: - When `~/.gemini/antigravity-cli` exists, `statusLine` in `settings.json` is configured automatically (existing third-party `statusLine.command` entries are left untouched) to render a single-line ANSI bar (`● 1 active 38.1 t/s | 0.85s | ◎ 17%`). - Toggle via `/statusline` in `agy` or **Preferences → Structure → Mount & Capsule Bar**. 5. **Standalone Web Server (Headless / Remote)**: ```bash # 1. Start on the host (listens on 127.0.0.1:8787 by default) node ~/.gemini/config/plugins/usage-monitor/sidecars/panel/standalone.mjs --port 8787 # 2. Forward the port locally and open http://localhost:8787 ssh -L 8787:127.0.0.1:8787 user@your-server ```
Standalone CLI flags, background auto-start, and non-loopback token auth - **Auto-start with `agy`**: Set `USAGE_MONITOR_STANDALONE_PORT=8787` or `"standalonePort": 8787` in `~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/sidecar_data/usage-monitor/panel/data/settings.json` to start the web UI together with the MCP sidecar supervisor. - **Non-loopback auth**: Binding to `0.0.0.0` or a LAN address requires `--token ` (or `USAGE_MONITOR_STANDALONE_TOKEN`); starting on a non-loopback address without a token is rejected. - **Overrides**: Supports `--data-dir`, `--app-data-dir`, `--gemini-dir`, `--ls-addr`, and `--csrf-token`. - **Offline fallback**: When `agy` is not running, the backend reads `~/.gemini/antigravity-cli` (`conversation_summaries.db`, `conversations/*.db`, `annotations/*.pbtxt`, and `transcript.jsonl`) and switches to live RPC once `agy` starts.
--- ## Configuration & Calculation Notes
UI options: mount mode, capsule slots, token formats, model IDs, and context limits - **Mount Mode & Width**: Switch between **Dual-mount (Top Bar + Sidebar)**, **Composer**, and **Sidebar only**. Popover width defaults to **Auto Fit** (expands within window bounds for wide tables) or a fixed width (`440–1080 px`). - **Capsule Slots**: Choose 1–5 metric slots and reorder them (default: Output Speed, TTFT, Context Usage), plus an optional toggle for the active-session indicator. - **Call Details Table & Token Format**: Toggle agent badges, turn rail (off by default), and speed color grading (off by default). Choose `Ctx / Think / Reply`, `In / Out / Cache` (with per-item USD tooltips), or custom format strings like `context:new:cache` or `in:out:cache`. - **Model Name Format**: Choose **Compact short alias** (`argon-4-high`), **Full raw ID**, or **Trimmed raw ID** (strips `gemini-` / `claude-` / `gpt-` prefixes while keeping `·compact` suffixes intact). Orchestrator series IDs have a separate setting. - **Per-Model Context Limits**: Configure limits per model across thinking levels or follow host defaults under **Preferences → Other → Model Context Settings**. App/IDE applies saved rules at startup; CLI sets `AGY_CLI_AUTO_COMPACT_OVERRIDE`.
Model identification, compaction inference, and cost estimation rules - **Model Resolution**: Read from each step's raw usage payload or matching generator metadata; explicit models are never overwritten. When an automatic compaction step omits the model field, it is inferred from adjacent steps in the same conversation (checking prior steps first, then following steps, preferring the same provider) for display and estimation, or shown as unknown compaction if none exist. - **Cost Calculation**: If a model or price entry cannot be resolved, step cost is shown as pending while tokens still count toward totals; session totals sum all resolved steps. USD numbers are estimated from public per-million-token API pricing in [`pricing-catalog.json`](pricing-catalog.json) for reference only and do **not** reflect subscription quota consumption. - **Cache & Speed Averages**: Upgrading re-checks cached entries against raw trajectory data while preserving token counts and valid timings. Compaction steps display request TPS in step tables but are excluded from session speed and TTFT averages.
Updating and data directory - **In-Panel Update**: When a new GitHub release is available, a version badge appears next to the capsule and in the panel header. Update mode (`Manual` / `Auto` / `Off`) and price catalog sync can be configured under **Preferences → Other**. - **Manual Git Update**: - Windows: `git -C "$env:USERPROFILE\.gemini\config\plugins\usage-monitor" pull --ff-only` - macOS / Linux: `git -C ~/.gemini/config/plugins/usage-monitor pull --ff-only` - Toggle the plugin off and back on in **Customizations → Installed**. - **Data Persistence**: Settings and parsed caches live in `~/.gemini/antigravity/sidecar_data/usage-monitor/` (or `sidecars/panel/.data/` in standalone mode), so updates keep existing history intact.
--- ## Local Development All backend and frontend modules use Node.js ESM and native Web Components with **no external npm dependencies** (Node.js 22.5+ is recommended for built-in `node:sqlite`). ```bash cd sidecars/panel # Rebuild app.js and styles.css after modifying src/ npm run build # Run unit and integration tests npm test ``` ## Contributing & License Issues and pull requests are welcome. If you modify files under `sidecars/panel/src/`, please rebuild via `npm run build` and make sure `npm test` passes. Licensed under the [GNU General Public License v3.0](LICENSE). ## Star History
